eloureHome.collectionsBody: Each composed with skincare-level concentrations and finished with fine fragrance.
eloureHome.scentBody: Composed by Cécile Zarokian, carried through the entire Éloure care collection. Bright cardamom and bergamot open onto a floral-gourmand heart of chai latte and frangipani, settling into a warm trail of sandalwood, vanilla and soft musk.

skincare.title: Skincare-level performance
skincare.body: The discipline of luxury skincare brought into haircare, with high concentrations of active ingredients delivering visible, lasting results.

fragrance.title: Fine fragrance craftsmanship
fragrance.body: A signature scent composed by award-winning perfumer Cécile Zarokian, infused into every Éloure product.

salon.title: Salon authority
salon.body: Five decades of backstage mastery shaping every formulation, refined for the ritual of daily care.

eloureHome.worldBody: Éloure was created to redefine professional luxury haircare. Rooted in salon credibility and shaped by Parisian refinement, the brand brings together performance and experience in a clear, confident way.

eauHome.awakenBody: EAUde1974 awakens the creative mind using all sensorial aspects, delivering luxury products with fragrance, colour and design.
eauHome.statementEnd: where fine fragrances transform your daily beauty routine.

capri.body: Close your eyes and feel the vibrant energy of Capri around you. A fresh and fruity scent: a daily escape to the citrus-kissed breezes, golden sands and shimmering azure waters of the Mediterranean island.
notes: Citrusy with a dash of woody

hamptons.body: Discover the charm of the Hamptons with a spicy, warm and woody scent. Picture yourself strolling through grand estates, where ocean breezes mingle with blooming hydrangeas.

santorini.body: Immerse yourself in the magic of Santorini with a spicy, powdery and warm scent. Cobblestone streets, blue-domed churches, island romance with a hint of daydream.
